hooks.name: Sync BLOG_GUIDE on source changes
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to keep BLOG_GUIDE.md in sync whenever a component, CSS, or lib file is saved

action.prompt:
A source file in src/ was just saved. Check whether the change adds, removes, or significantly modifies any of the following — if yes, update content/docs/BLOG_GUIDE.md to reflect the current state before finishing:
- A component in src/components/ (update Section 2 file tree and Section 6 CSS classes table)
- A new CSS class or responsive breakpoint in globals.css (update Section 6 breakpoints table)
- A new npm script in package.json (update Section 9 deployment commands)
- A new authoring convention or markdown feature in posts.ts (update Section 5 writing style)

If the saved file is a minor bug fix or style tweak with no structural impact on authoring workflow, no update is needed. Use your judgement — the guide documents HOW TO USE the blog system, not every implementation detail.
